Roles & Responsibilities
Salary: Up to $3,800
Location: Alexandra Road, near Labrador Park MRT
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 8.30am – 5.30pm
Benefits: Monthly Transport Reimbursement
Our client, an established Japanese MNC in the automotive industry, is seeking an Operations Support Coordinator to join its supply chain operations team.
Job Responsibilities
Handle order creation, processing, amendments and follow-ups to ensure timely and accurate execution.
Prepare and manage shipping documents.
Coordinate with customers, suppliers and internal departments on operational matters.
Verify and process supplier invoices, freight and insurance charges.
Investigate billing discrepancies and coordinate necessary corrections.
Prepare monthly reports and maintain accurate operational records.
Support data management, RPA, AI and other automation-related processes.
Identify operational issues and assist in process improvements.
Perform other operational and administrative duties as assigned.
Job Requirements
Diploma or Degree in any discipline.
Candidates with or without relevant working experience are welcome to apply.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Comfortable handling data, computer systems and technology-related tasks.
Knowledge of supply chain operations, import/export documentation, Incoterms or Purchase Order processing will be an advantage.
Good communication, coordination and problem-solving skills.
Detail-oriented, responsible and willing to learn.
Able to work independently and as part of a team.
Interested applicants, please email your resume to lilian@juhlerprofessionals.com.sg
